integrity: The stated normalization is the full Euclidean directional width divided by the number of Boolean vectors, including the zero vector as a harmless zero term. No extrapolation from finite computational results is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional Gaussian-replacement and moment statements have self-contained analytic proofs but no independent verification; computations check only finite examples. The geometric law may have an uncatalogued equivalent in literature on Boolean-subset zonotopes.
title: Diagonal sufficiency and nonconcentrating spherical widths of the White Whale zonotope
